A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MR-LFADS research and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–F. Text extraction and rendered-page inspection support comparison of the equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v4 reports original simulation experiments and model evaluations on 37 synthetic datasets, plus original analyses of existing mouse electrophysiology recordings, including photoinhibition predictions and consistency across model initializations.

after.justification: v5 reports the same original synthetic-data evaluations and model-based electrophysiology analyses in Sections 4–5, with supporting empirical results in the appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A retain the same architecture, causal inference procedures, rate-derived communication, inferred external inputs, and weighted KL objective. The MR-LFADS variants and their procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the memory network, pass-decision network, 35 randomly configured task-trained networks, and the same mouse electrophysiology sessions. Task families, recorded regions, and photoinhibition scenarios remain unchanged.

E2.justification: RRR, mp-srSLDS, and MR-SDS retain their membership in the corresponding synthetic comparisons. The MR-LFADS S/F/G variant comparisons and the R-versus-G electrophysiology consistency comparison are also unchanged (Figures 2–5).

E3.justification: The synthetic training/validation splits, held-out neurons, model settings, reconstruction and communication metrics, and held-out photoinhibition protocol are unchanged. Appendices A–D and F retain the same experimental specifications.

E4.justification: Both retain the input-specification and communication-source ablations, temporal-lag analyses, photoinhibition validation, and consistency analysis. Appendix E's KL channel-pruning and SVD analyses, including Figures S4–S5, are identical.

E5.justification: Both report ten seeds for Experiments 1–2, one fit per random synthetic network, and five seeds for electrophysiology consistency. The box-plot definitions, Figure 4 significance tests, and standard-deviation reporting are unchanged despite caption copyediting.

E6.justification: Figures 2–5 and S1–S5 retain identical plotted results and numerical summaries, including Figure 4's p-values. Reconstruction, communication recovery, photoinhibition predictions, and consistency findings are unchanged; no result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: Equations 1–20 and their mathematical content are unchanged, including the model distributions, training objective, RRR derivation, and effectome definition. No formal assumption, proof, or mathematical argument is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract receives wording edits while retaining the same claims about disentangling communication, outperforming existing approaches on synthetic networks, and predicting held-out perturbation effects. The introduction and discussion retain the same contributions and scope.

C2.justification: The mechanism interpretations and limitations remain intact, including hyperparameter sensitivity, uncertainty about latent representations, and confounding from unrecorded common inputs. Appendix E's explanations are unchanged.

D1.justification: v5 adds a Code Availability section on page 9 stating that a PyTorch implementation is available and providing the golub-lab/MR-LFADS GitHub address. v4 lacks this access disclosure. Existing implementation and hyperparameter documentation is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list are unchanged. Both versions position MR-LFADS relative to static communication models, switching dynamical systems, and single-region LFADS in the same way.

P1.justification: v5 makes limited copyedits to the abstract, method/results prose, captions, and acknowledgments, and adds the short Code Availability section. The main narrative and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 2 and 5 have shortened captions, accompanied by small shifts in figure placement and text flow. Figure artwork, axes, panels, and table structures are unchanged; the reference and appendix pages render identically.

improvement.justification: The new Code Availability section supplies a previously missing implementation link, improving code discoverability and reproducibility documentation. Limited copyediting also streamlines the presentation while preserving the scientific evidence and limitations. The gain is modest; the PDFs alone do not establish the repository's completeness or usability.
